name: ui-markup-a11y-check
description: Read built HTML pages (one file, several, or a folder) and report the accessibility problems that are visible in the markup: images with no alt, buttons, links and form fields with no name, no lang, no title, a viewport that blocks zoom, skipped heading levels, duplicate ids, aria references to missing ids, vague link text, a positive tabindex, autoplay media, focusable content inside aria-hidden and data tables with no headers. Each finding has its file, line and column and quotes the page it rests on. Never runs a script, no dependencies.
author: INNERLUXES <info@innerluxes.dev>
